newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Eurodollars, Euroyen crawl to flat finish.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Eurodollars, Euroyen crawl to flat finish.

text.p: SIMEX Eurodollars and Euroyen futures ended steady in lacklustre trading on Tuesday.
Dealers said Eurodollar futures were trapped in narrow ranges with little fresh news to move them.
"There is nothing happening in the market. There was some light profit-taking but not much else going on," said a dealer with a European bank.

He said market participants were likely to stay sidelined ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting next week, though most do not expect any change in interest rates after the recent spate of subdued U.S. inflation data.
"I think the market could go a bit softer from here but December Eurodollars should see some support at 94.10," he said.
December Eurodollars ended at 94.14 against their IMM close at 94.15 with 7,900 contracts traded.
Euroyen futures also had a dull day with the March contract hovering within a three tick range.
Dealers said there was nothing new on the economic front and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) was unlikely to change its easy monetary stance.
"The weak GDP (Gross Domestic Product) figures last Friday just confirm that the BOJ is not going to hike rates so the undertone of the market should be quite firm," said a dealer.
March Euroyen finished at 99.16 against a CME close at 99.15 on turnover of 9,015 lots.
Japanese government bond futures also ended firmer with the December contract settling at 122.15 against its open at 121.54.
